trip.title: Trip Journal Entry
trip.description: Represents an individual curated travel journal entry (volume) captured by a traveler.

id.description: The unique identifier of the journal entry.

title.description: The editorial title of the journey.

location.description: The geographical name of the location visited.

coordinates.description: Spatial coordinates on the world map.

startDate.description: The starting date of the journey.

endDate.description: The ending date of the journey.

coverImage.description: URL to the high-contrast cover photo.

isPublic.description: Whether this journal entry is public to other travelers.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this journal entry.

chatMessage.title: Assistant Chat Message
chatMessage.description: Represents a conversational message exchanged between the traveler and the Editorial AI Assistant.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user participating in the chat.

content.description: The text content of the message.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

/trips/{tripId}.description: Global collection containing all traveler journal volumes.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Subcollection under each user mapping their historical dialog with the Travel Assistant.
